modifier.tinkersnewlife.all_paths_one.de: Default Wizard Set trait: mana, curse and souls cover each other - a mana shortfall eats curse then souls, a soul shortfall eats curse then mana, and a curse shortfall eats souls then mana. Rates (mod-wide): 1 EE = 1 mana = 4 souls = 2 curse.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.all_paths_one.fl: All paths lead to the same place; mana, curse and soul are one substance.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.all_paths_one.ti: §d1 mana = 4 souls, 1 curse = 2 souls - the three pools cover each other
modifier.tinkersnewlife.all_spells_unity: Greatly raises your max mana, and Echoing Strikes and Abyssal Shroud stand with you!
Every path of magic ends in the same place.
§bMax mana +%1$s; on hit: level %2$s Echoing Strikes (%3$ss); at 20%% health: level %4$s Abyssal Shroud (%5$ss)
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ancient_sanctuar: Reduces all damage you take and raises your fire spell power
The old shield is worn, but its oath holds.
§a-5% damage taken (stacks per piece); Fire spell power +25%
modifier.tinkersnewlife.anti_gravity.des: Forward (technique key C): all creatures within the radius (scaled by curse output & affinity), except the caster, are levitated; each target costs one unit of curse power. Reversal (F): deploy a pressure field - targets resist by body size & max HP (slowness below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it). Costs curse power per second. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.arcane_conductio: Flowing arcana empowers the spells you cast - use it to deal far greater spell damage.
Arcane affinity, released with a magician's mastery.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.biting_frost.des: Hits inflict Frostbite on the enemy.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.biting_frost.fla: Frost in the bone, biting to the touch.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.biting_frost.tip: §bHits freeze the enemy for %1$s s (cooldown %2$s s)
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_bird.descr: Activate to spawn a black bird (bat) at your position and take control of it: W/S fly forward/backward along your full look direction (look up to climb, look down to descend), A/D strafe horizontally, Space gives extra ascent; press Shift to dive and self-destruct (no block damage; center damage = (1 + affinity/100) x (output x 3 + bat health) x 10, radius 2). Press the release key again to recall it and refund half the curse energy; the view returns when the bird dies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_bird.flavo: Black wings carry your sight beyond the body.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_flash.desc: Each hit has a chance to land a Black Flash for massive damage; after it triggers, your Black Flash chance as well as your speed, attack and jump are boosted for a short while
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_flash.flav: For one instant, the world is one step late.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.descri: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the armor extra defense slots, but you take more damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.flavor: Those who defile the gods are forsaken by them.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blazing.descript: Attacks have a chance to ignite the target, and every attack adds a burst of fire spell damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blazing.flavor: A sun pulled from the ashes still burns.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blazing.tip: %1$s%% chance to ignite for 5s; appends Fire spell damage: %2$s%% of the hit
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blood_manipulati: Technique Blood Manipulation - combines Chuan Xue / Bai Lian / Supernova into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Chuan Xue -> Bai Lian -> Supernova: Chuan Xue = spend 5% max HP, fire a blood beam piercing 20 blocks, one hit per target of (1+affinity/100)x(output+blood x5); Bai Lian = spend 7% HP, lock a target by sight, five blood pillars dealing 5 hits (each = Chuan Xue single-target /2); Supernova = spend 10% HP, lock a target by sight, spawn a blood orb that explodes after 0.8s (center damage x blood x10, falling with distance). Ignores i-frames; armor still applies. Uses a technique slot.
Blood as a blade, piercing ten thousand foes.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.butcher.descript: While worn, all illagers (including witches) and villagers actively flee and never attack you, and you gain soul energy ×2.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.butcher.flavor: The butcher walks, and the wicked scatter.
Each hit builds Fever, and attack speed scales with it; hold a direction key while attacking to spend 20 Fever and blink; at full Fever, hold W + Shift + right-click to unleash a finisher slash.
Butterflies scatter where the blade passes.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.chaos_flow.descr: No one can adapt to your kaleidoscope of damage types...
modifier.tinkersnewlife.chaos_flow.flavo: One cut, one colour - never the same twice.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.chaos_flow.tip: §dEach attack rolls: physical  or  one school's spell damage (single instance, no split)§7 (never the same type 3 times in a row: two in a row forces a change)
modifier.tinkersnewlife.charm.descriptio: Hitting a creature charms it: while charmed it cannot attack you and will not target you. Cooldown 30s.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.charm.flavor: A glance, and the will is no longer its own.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.child_of_the_sta: Born under every star at once.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cold_blooded.des: Each attack adds a burst of ice-school spell damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cold_blooded.fla: Cold to the bone, cold to the heart.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cold_blooded.tip: Appends Ice spell damage: %1$s%% of the hit
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.descri: When you attack a non-illager target, nearby illagers have a chance to switch their attack target to the one you are attacking.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.flavor: Command the rabble; strike the foe together.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.construct.descri: Forward (technique key C): toggles Infinite Ammo mode - while holding a weapon that draws ammo from your inventory (vanilla bows/crossbows, Tinkers bows, TACZ guns, etc.), running dry spends curse energy to conjure the matching arrow/bullet. Reverse (reverse key F): opens the construct inventory; pick any item that has a crafting recipe - its curse energy cost is computed from its value and power and deducted at once, then construction begins. 1 curse energy = 1 tick of build time; you move slower and cannot reverse again while working, and being hit interrupts it without refunding the energy. On completion you receive a temporary item that fades after 60 seconds. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.construct.flavor: Nothing comes from nothing - only from will.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.corruption.descr: Each attack consumes soul energy to boost damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.corruption.flavo: Burn the grudge, forge it into a blade.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cosmic_order_voi: Hitting a target inflicts Slowness and Blindness, with duration scaling per level. Triggers have a 20s cooldown.
The spheres speak, and the small things stumble.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_output.des: Determines your curse domain radius (5 blocks per level), curse energy cap and regeneration.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_output.fla: How loudly the curse answers your call.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_speed.desc: Shortens cursed speech chant time and speeds up the Construction Technique conjuration; higher levels are faster. Curse cores only.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_speed.flav: No need to draw the words out; the world answers on the first roll of the tongue.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_total.desc: Curse energy cap = Curse Total level x (Curse Output level + curse affinity/10) x 500.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_total.flav: A well deep enough to drown in.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_adrenalin: When you take damage, fear makes energy flow through your body and raises your speed
Between life and death, cursed blood surges.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_energy_re: Forward: fire a bolt of pure curse energy along your look, dealing heavy damage on impact. Reverse: Granite Blast - curse energy pours out as a continuous laser, dealing i-frame-ignoring damage every 2 ticks for 3 seconds, steerable by turning your view; afterwards forward and reverse share a 6 second cooldown. Unaffected by technique burnout.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_speech.de: Forward (technique key C): chant your current curse speech - a six-part line of exclamation, honorific plus target, prayer plus core meaning, and closing thanks. Chanting takes time and is interrupted by hits without refunding; after release the backlash is calculated from the target's health and your output/affinity. Reverse (reverse key F): opens the curse speech editor. Words are learned from Ancient Cursed Scrolls, found randomly in loot chests. Exclamation gives curse energy cost, honorific gives effect strength, prayer gives duration, closing thanks reduces backlash. Curse output and affinity form your Curse Power (1 + (output + affinity/10)/10), which boosts both the effect and the area radius (6 blocks x power), affecting every non-ally living entity inside. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_speech.fl: Words the world is obliged to answer.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_spirit.de: Forward: when a cursed spirit within sight drops to 2.5% health or less, record that individual into the GUI (full NBT) and make it disperse (instantly ending boss fights); the cost depends on its max health plus your output and affinity, and you gain 30s Hunger and 10s Nausea. Otherwise it opens the individual list (scroll bar + 3D display): click to release a full-health individual (it serves you and only attacks what threatens you or what you attack), click a released one again to recall it; if a released individual dies its record is lost. Reverse (F): choose an unreleased individual as a sacrifice, charge a black vortex, then press F again to fire it along your look (damage = that spirit's max health x 40%, so it scales with the sacrificed individual's max health, then multiplied by the Modular Staff's spell amplification). Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_spirit.fl: The dead stay loyal, if you hold the leash.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dang_yun_ping_xi: Domain expansion: the interior floods with seawater - the caster cannot drown (same-team shikigami/spirits/guards get water breathing too; New Shadow techniques can resist this drowning hazard, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable), while other creatures follow normal air rules. The domain keeps a swarm of drowned minions owned by the caster (6 + radius/2, up to 24): they actively hunt every non-allied target inside and attack in melee, refill automatically when killed, ~1/5 carry tridents. Closing the domain restores everything - water vanishes, drowned are dismissed. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
A single boat upon ten thousand waves.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dark_metal_break: Attacks weaken the enemy; killing an enemy with Resistance has a chance to drop an emerald.
The curse will bring eternal sleep.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonbone.flavo: Bones that can carry a dragon's weight.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.dreadsteel_armor: While worn, keeps granting Night Vision, Fire Resistance, frost immunity and a damage cap; it all ends when you take the armor off
Armor woven from the thing that frightens the dark.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.earplugs.flavor: Plug your ears, and let them curse the heavens - it is only wind.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.endless_cold_win: While holding this tool to cast, your Ice-school spell power is increased by 25%.
The wind never stops; the cold never ends.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.descri: Upgrade: melee/ranged hits are resolved as piercing damage - ignoring i-frames and piercing through invulnerabilities and damage caps.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.flavor: The might of five Outer Gods pierces all things.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.desc: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool an extra ability slot, but lowers movement speed.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.flav: Sealed with the void, marked for the end.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flame_manipulati: Forward: melt the 3x3 blocks under a target in your sight (bedrock excepted) into blazing magma - a temporary pool that reverts after 3 seconds; anything standing in it takes continuous curse damage and is set alight. Reverse (key F): spend ceil(M x 100) to summon five 1/8-size phantoms with 1 health that self-destruct, waiting 1 second then ramming enemies in turn; each explosion equals the black bird's (radius 3), sets enemies alight and lights a 3x3 fire at their feet. Uses a technique slot.
Where it walks, the ground remembers being molten.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flying_sword.des: Right-click to launch the sword; it returns after hitting. Toggle pursuit mode to hunt enemies automatically.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flying_sword.fla: The blade that comes back on its own.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.focus.descriptio: While holding this tool your casting cannot be interrupted, and each level adds 5% cast speed.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.focus.flavor: An undivided mind completes every spell.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fumo_yuchuzi.des: Press the key to unfold the domain: every 2 ticks it releases slashes at all creatures and players inside except the caster, with sweep particle effects, ignoring i-frames and leaving redstone-dust blood on the ground (breaking it drops nothing). Each slash deals (1 + (Curse Output level + curse affinity/10)/10) x (current attack damage + Curse Output level x 5) x 5%, and can be reduced or even negated by armor, shields and other defenses. Drains radius x 40 curse energy per second (twice Zuo Sha Bo Tu).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fumo_yuchuzi.fla: A kitchen that must serve every guest at once.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fus_ro_dah.descr: Hits launch the target away; the higher the level, the stronger the push.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fus_ro_dah.flavo: Three words, and the mountain moves.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.descr: Domain expansion: opens around the entity you look at (the defendant); all entities inside except the caster are frozen, and Shin'yagyu skills do not help. Non-player defendants are found guilty after 5 seconds no matter the type (attack power zeroed for 60s). Player defendants get a 6 second trial: guilt score = villagers killed + animals killed + players defeated, guilty above 100 (guilty players lose cursed tools, then techniques, then curse power for 60s). If guilty, the caster receives the Executioner Sword, which only executes the defendant of this trial - or a non-player creature that has killed you before - and deals 200% damage to anything else (players can never be executed this way). Costs radius x 20 curse per second. Uses a domain slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.flavo: The court is in session; the guilty shall die.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ghost_clearing.f: Seeing is not believing - it is dismissing.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.godrealm_overste: Immunity to explosion, fire and magic damage
One step past the mortal realm.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.hastur_malice.de: Attacks create a wind field that pulls nearby creatures in and deals continuous damage to everything inside.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.hastur_malice.fl: The wind gathers before it tears.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.holy_war_relic.d: Grants extra upgrade, defense and ability slots.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.holy_war_relic.f: Holy war never ends; relics never fade.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.inscription.desc: Lets your tool hold inscribed spells and raises your spell power.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.inscription.flav: What is carved into the hide is a curse.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.jacobs_ladder.fl: A stair lowered from the sky, for judgement alone.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.de: New Shadow Style - Simple Domain (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - a small barrier resists domain effects (including Unlimited Void's stun); you can move and use items, but cannot use techniques while it lasts. Costs 24 curse power/sec.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.fl: A small world of your own that turns force aside.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.descri: Just treat it as Broken Radiance and you are fine (
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.flavor: The blazing brand that severs the sun light.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.lightning_manipu: Forward: strike a target in your sight with lightning (purely visual - it does not use vanilla lightning damage or conversion); the damage is dealt as curse damage (80% of your damage basis). modifier.tinkersnewlife.lucky_drop.flavo: The dead keep giving, if you ask twice.

modifier.tinkersnewlife.mana_surge.flavo: Mana wells up from the plates and flows back through the veins.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.mana_surge.tip: §bWith %s piece(s): +%s max mana, +%s%% spell power, +%s%% spell damage

modifier.tinkersnewlife.mixu_gelong.flav: Wrapped in a cocoon, still as a mountain.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.modular_staff.de: Adds +1.5 melee damage; spells and curse techniques (Kai / Ba / Zao Kai) gain bonus damage and increased power.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.nyarlathotep_des: Grants an extra ability slot per level
A gift that asks for more each time.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.order_origin.des: Any damage you take is recomputed as physical damage before it is applied to you, so your armor, curios and attributes can reduce it normally.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.origin_magic.des: Raises the level of spells you cast, and you ignore the forbidden taint of eldritch arts.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.origin_magic.fla: The first magic never needed permission.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.origin_magic.tip: §dAll spells +%1$s levels; eldritch needs no learning
modifier.tinkersnewlife.pale_plating.des: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool an extra upgrade slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.plant_manipulati: Forward: press the release key to open a selection screen (Roots / Curse Seed), then charge, aim at an enemy and press again to release. Roots grow a sweet berry bush under the target (2 seconds to full growth without fruiting, lasting 3 seconds, slowing and dealing curse damage - and it cannot be broken or destroyed, dropping nothing). Curse Seed inflicts parasitism on the target (attack -40%, Curse Total/Output -1 level, affinity -60). Reverse (key F): absorb plants within a 5x5x5 area around you and convert them into curse energy (grass block to dirt +1; grass/flower/sapling +3; leaves +8). Uses a technique slot.
Green things listen, if you speak their language.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.projection.descr: Activate to spawn a phantom of yourself along your look on the same horizontal plane (distance = 2/3 to 1 times your maximum straight-line movement in 1 second). Touching the phantom within 1 second grants a 10 second buff: damage, jump and speed x2. Costs a fixed 800 cursed energy. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.projection.flavo: Step where you are not, and be there.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.puppet.descripti: Activate to summon an iron or snow golem in front of you (chosen in the GUI) and transfer your view into it: the iron golem attacks with left-click, launches with right-click and self-destructs with Shift (radius 5, no block damage); the snow golem throws snowballs with right-click (frost on hit) and self-destructs with Shift (radius 3, with frost). Press the release key again to recall it and refund 30% of the curse energy; your view returns when the puppet dies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.puppet.flavor: Borrow a body that does not fear breaking.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.de: Domain expansion: forcibly stuns every target inside (except the caster - cannot move; New Shadow techniques CAN resist this domain's stun, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Then summons ALL ten shadows shikigami x2 (all tamed, scaled by the caster's curse affinity/output) to hunt every target inside the domain. Closing the domain dismisses every summoned shikigami. Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.fl: Within the shadow court, ten thousand beasts arise.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.quantum_bag.desc: Stores items in a pocket of your own personal dimension.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.quantum_bag.flav: Storage that is never quite anywhere.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.resonance.descri: The silent glove no longer intercepts sounds: everything is heard normally while worn (its other functions are unaffected). Slotless upgrade.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.resonance.flavor: The bell rings, the sculk answers, and silence shatters.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.reverse_cursed.d: Press the technique key (C) to cast Reverse Cursed Technique on yourself - spend Curse Output x 10 curse energy to restore (1 + (affinity/10 + output)/10) x output x 2 health. Press the reverse key (F) to cast it outward: it heals the target; if the target is undead it instead takes damage equal to twice the amount that would have been healed. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.reverse_cursed.f: To unmake the wound by unmaking the harm.
Domain expansion (guaranteed-hit domain): every projectile the caster fires is steered each tick toward the nearest hostile target inside the domain - even a stray shot curves to hit. Empty left-clicks (swinging at air, at any distance) while holding a Construct technique temp item or a ranged weapon also land a guaranteed strike on the nearest hostile target inside (scaled by the player's attack damage). Targets: every living creature inside except the caster's own team. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
Three calamities converge; nothing can be avoided.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.shi_bao_yue_gong: Domain expansion: moonlight freezes into time-cells - every target inside (except the caster) is hit by the same standstill stun as a failed Projection Technique (cannot move/attack/use items/turn the view; refreshed every 5 ticks until the domain ends). Players with the Heavenly Restriction - Tyrant body (curse-less pure physical power) are IMMUNE to this domain's stun - the moon's light cannot bind a body without curse. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Closing the domain instantly releases everyone inside. Costs radius x55 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
Moonlight freezes into time-cells; within one palace, every thought halts.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.silent_glove.des: While empty-handed, automatically draws a weapon from your singularity storage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.silent_glove.fla: The hand that never needs to reach.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.sky_manipulation: Forward: if a hostile target is in your sight, launch and push it along your look (pure displacement); with no target, give yourself a push along your look (a dash or a leap). Reverse (key F): fire a Usoroton at the target you have locked onto - on hit it shatters space like thin ice, blasting the opponent away and dealing curse damage (the hit carries your core material traits). Push, damage and cost all scale with curse affinity and output. Uses a technique slot.
The sky is a surface, if you stand on it correctly.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.fl: Every mote of soul accounted for.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.ti: §e5% soul energy cost reduction per level
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.descr: Each level increases the soul energy you gain
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.flavo: Souls as food, the more you sip the richer.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_repair.desc: While held or worn, the tool spends soul energy to repair itself.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_repair.flav: A soul-powered repair kit, always with you!
modifier.tinkersnewlife.spell_break.desc: Comes with a built-in inscribed Counterspell.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.spell_break.empt: §7Not inscribed yet (injected while in your inventory)
modifier.tinkersnewlife.star_child_armor: While worn, kills increase your max health; each armor piece stores its own kill count, and once one is full the count carries over to the next piece.
Every death adds a little more sky to you.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.super_tier_magic: Inscribed spells gain a massive boost to level and power!
Above the highest tier there is another tier.
§dInscribed spells: power = their level cap x2 (range x3, duration x2)
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.d: Domain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is crushed by pressure equal to 2x the Anti-Gravity reversal pressure (scales with curse affinity/output). Targets resist by body size & max HP: slow below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it. This domain's pressure CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (Mikoshi Kago / Falling Blossom / Simple Domain). Costs radius x30 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.f: All things to one; all bear the weight.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.descr: Forward (technique key C, requires line of sight): divide the target into ten equal parts and summon a golden weak-point orb at the seventh mark (70% height, in front of the target, follows it, lasts 20s). Hitting that orb with any of your damage triggers a crit on the target - damage x crit multiplier (1.3 + output x0.08 + affinity x0.004); the orb shatters after one hit. Pressing C again on a marked target performs a guaranteed precise slash. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.flavo: Divide into ten; one strike to the heart.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_shadows.desc: Press the technique release key to open the shikigami selection screen: summoning a shikigami costs curse energy (upkeep is free), and its size, speed and base stats scale with your curse affinity and Curse Output. Only Divine Dog is available at first; the other nine must be tamed - the first time you summon an untamed shikigami it attacks both you and your locked target, and defeating it tames it. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_shadows.flav: Ten shadows, and only one of them is yours yet.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_shadows.maho: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
modifier.tinkersnewlife.tie_guan_gai_wei: Domain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is kept on fire, and takes a curse-scorch hit every 5 ticks that ignores invulnerability frames (0.6 + output x0.35 + affinity x0.01 per hit; armor/resistance still applies). This domain CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x50 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
The iron coffin topples; the mountain burns.
At half health you unleash 7 waves of Raise Hell and summon 2 Ancient Knights to protect you.
Below half health: summon 2 Ancient Knights (150s) + instant Raise Hell Lv5, cooldown 150s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.west_tiger.descr: When applied to a Black Flash weapon, it further raises the base Black Flash trigger chance
modifier.tinkersnewlife.west_tiger.flavo: The tiger that waits at the western gate.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wu_wei.descripti: Press P to open the form selection screen (killing a creature records its form). Press the technique key (C) for the forward mode: transform yourself into the chosen creature, inheriting all of its base attributes but none of its abilities or AI, with your view transferred into it; press C again to return to human form. Press the reverse key (F) to toggle Transmutation Outward: the next attack transforms the target (creature or player) into the chosen creature - creature targets are changed permanently and become guardian shikigami (death is then true death), while player targets revert automatically after 60 seconds and cannot use tools meanwhile. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wu_wei.flavor: Change the shape, and the life follows.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_cang.des: Press the technique key (C) to begin charging Blue; press again to fire a sky-blue orb forward that drags entities within 10 blocks toward its center (the caster excepted), exploding when an entity touches the center. Press the reverse key (F) to fire Blue's reversal, Red: a bright red orb that pushes entities away - ones pushed into blocks take damage based on their speed, and touching its center explodes for twice Blue's damage. Press F while Blue is charging to combine them into Hollow Technique: Purple and fire it directly, destroying every block it touches (bedrock excepted, no drops) and dealing ten times Blue's explosion damage to entities hit. All three orbs travel at most 40 blocks; Blue and Red vanish when they hit blocks. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_cang.fla: Attraction, repulsion, and the hollow between them.
Press the key to unfold the domain: every creature and player except the opener is frozen in place (unable to attack, move, use items, switch hotbar slots or open their inventory) while still affected by physics; when it closes, the stun continues for (time inside/10 + Curse Output level) x (1 + curse affinity/100) x 10 ticks. Drains radius x 80 curse energy per second (four times Zuo Sha Bo Tu). Creatures resist by health and players by curse affinity.
Infinite information, and no way to think it.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_wuxian.d: Press the technique release key (C) to switch it on and press again to switch it off (a toggle that persists across technique changes). While active, damage up to the threshold is negated at no cost; damage above it spends curse energy per point of overflow, and when the energy runs out it switches off automatically and you take one shield-break hit (overflow x 5). With infinite curse energy the overflow is absorbed instead (never shield-breaks). Threshold = 10 + output x 2 + affinity x 0.1 (output 5 / affinity 0 = 20). Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yog_sothoth_gift: While holding this tool, experience gained is greatly increased
Time is a currency, and the gate pays generously.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.descript: Technique Yu Chu Zi - combines Kai / Ba / Zao Kai into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Kai -> Ba -> Zao Kai: Kai = a single slash at a looked-at target (70% of the shared base, ignores i-frames, armor still applies); Ba = six slashes at a target within 3 blocks (each half of Kai's damage); Zao Kai = hold C to charge a flame arrow in your main hand, release to fire it (explodes on impact, 200% center damage falling with distance). Curse cost: Kai x1 / Ba x2 / Zao Kai x10 of the base.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.flavor: The stove-fire burns; the blade strikes like fate.
Domain expansion: you enter a borrowed-technique state - switch freely among every technique you have unlocked in this save's Patchouli guide (switch key cycles the unlocked set; any unlocked technique can be cast instantly). Only while the domain is active: closing/leaving restores the technique selected before expansion. Costs radius x25 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
True and false entwined; every art is mine.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zi_bi_yuan_dun_g: Domain expansion: each target inside (except the caster) is transfigured once - mobs are replaced by guardian shikigami of the chosen form (tamed, permanent); players are forcibly morphed for 60s (tools disabled). The form is the caster's Wu Wei selection if set (requires the Wu Wei technique); otherwise random zombie or skeleton. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
Touch and transform; life reshaped by hand.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zuosha_botu.desc: Press the key to unfold the domain and lock enemies in: it drains radius x 20 curse energy per second and closes automatically when empty. Every 3 seconds the domain draws a prize (70% small / 29% large / 1% grand; after 10 misses in a row the 11th is guaranteed grand). Small: +250 curse energy and 10 seconds of Absorption IV. Large: +900 curse energy and 30 seconds of Regeneration. Grand: unlimited curse energy for 33 seconds, health locked to its maximum, and +100 curse affinity.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zuosha_botu.flav: Sit, kill, and let the dice decide.
